name: Can you match existing door trim styles and colors during a repair?

mainEntity.name: Can you match existing door trim styles and colors during a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, matching existing door trim styles and colors is a key part of ensuring a seamless repair. We take care to select replacement trim that closely matches the profile and dimensions of your current trim. For color, we can custom-mix paints or stains to achieve an exact match, or at least a very close approximation, blending the repaired area with the surrounding trim. Achieving a perfect match often depends on the age and condition of the existing trim's finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: We aim to match existing door trim styles, profiles, and colors, often using custom paint or stain mixing for a seamless repair.
